tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Turns a screen recording into documentation: Easy Scribe writes numbered steps with a screenshot at each one, from what happens on screen and any narration, so recordings without audio work too. Takes video_url (a direct link to an .mp4, .webm or .mov file) or upload_path (from create_upload_url). E

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Uploads a screen recording to Easy Scribe, which turns it into documentation: a step-by-step guide, SOP, tutorial or user guide with screenshots. Use it when the user wants a document from a video they have; it works before they have named or picked the file. In apps that show MCP Apps (Claude, Chat

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Returns a document's status and, once completed, its full content with screenshot links that stay valid for 24 hours. Content is Markdown when unedited and HTML after edits in Easy Scribe.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists your most recent Easy Scribe documents, newest first. Optionally filter by title or status.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the document formats Easy Scribe can write from a recording (SOP, user guide, tutorial, release notes and more). Use a template id with create_document.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Lists the Easy Scribe workspaces you belong to. Documents go to your personal workspace unless you pass a workspace_id to create_document.

tools.name: share_document
tools.description: Creates a link to a document you own. anyone_with_link opens without signing in; signed_in requires an Easy Scribe account. Returns the link and an embed URL.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_document · Private data: create_document, create_upload_url, get_document, list_documents, list_templates, list_workspaces, share_document · Public sink: create_upload_url, share_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_document · Private data: create_document, create_upload_url, get_document, list_documents, list_templates, list_workspaces, share_document · Public sink: create_upload_url, share_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
